name: Night elf grove town
note: 2026-10-30 the owner asked for every race planned so far to be completed ("get all the races planned thus far complete"): the core set delivered whole and town_rules/nightelf.json written, so the race founds towns.

concept.setting: a night elf town in an ancient moonlit forest of colossal trees, eternal twilight under a huge pale moon, mist between the trunks, soft violet and teal light everywhere
concept.buildings: graceful buildings grown from living wood rather than built: walls of curved dark bark and pale polished timber, sweeping roofs shaped like great curling leaves and petals, rising to swept-up points, round and crescent-moon windows and doorways, tall slender arches, houses wrapped around the bases of giant trees and perched in their branches on curved platforms, carved owl and crescent-moon motifs, violet cloth awnings and banners
concept.landmark: a temple of the moon in a ring of pale stone: a tall open pavilion of slender columns under a sweeping crescent roof, a glowing moonwell pool at its heart reflecting the moon, a statue of a priestess with a raised hand, moonlight streaming down
concept.street_life: glowing violet and teal lamps hung from curled wooden posts like hanging flowers, a moonwell fountain, hippogryph roosts, archers' practice targets, wisps of light drifting between the trees, curving wooden bridges between giant trunks, druid stones circled by mushrooms
concept.greenery: moss-covered forest floor with ferns and glowing mushrooms, giant ancient trees with dark purple-green leaves, vines and hanging moss
concept.materials: dark oak and mangrove logs and wood, stripped dark oak, purple and magenta terracotta, purple wool and carpet, amethyst blocks, warped planks for teal accents, calcite and smooth quartz for pale stone, polished deepslate, soul lanterns, end rods and sea lanterns for moonlight, moss blocks, azalea leaves
concept.ground: moss and forest floor with ferns under giant trees

factions.about: Clans of one race, the same contract as orc, dwarf and goblin: one canonical palette per clan, the swaps from the authored base; the land chooses which clan settles where (styles/settlement.json). Each clan's `swaps` is its palette expanded to plain block ids for 1.21.1 (generated by src/styles/expand.mjs: read these, not the palette).
factions.base: the authored base materials (night elf parts are built in these and nothing else for walls, roofs and trim): dark_oak for living-wood trunks, timber, floors, doors, fences and balconies; purpur (purpur_block and its stairs and slabs, purpur_pillar) and purple_terracotta for the curling roofs; purple wool, carpet and banners for cloth (magenta only as a small cloth accent, never on roofs); amethyst_block for crystal accents; warped planks (and forms) for teal trim; smooth_quartz (and its stairs and slabs) and quartz_pillar for pale stone; polished_deepslate (and forms) for plinths; soul lanterns, end rods and sea lanterns for moonlight; moss_block and flowering azalea leaves; the yard surface red_sand and dead_bush (markers the placer swaps for the land's ground and plant)
